python3 -c "
import csv,numpy as np
from model import *
rows=[]
for fn in ['/app/data/abtest_000.csv','/app/data/abtest_003.csv','/app/data/abtest_001.csv','/app/data/abtest_002.csv']: rows+=list(csv.DictReader(open(fn)))
hist=list(csv.DictReader(open('/app/data/history.csv')))
def ratios(th,gB=7.2506,gA=3.0746):
    oW=[];pW=[];oa=[];pa=[]
    for r in rows:
        nA=float(r['requests_A']); nB=float(r['requests_B']); lam=(nA+nB)/3600
        m=(nA*gA+nB*gB)/(nA+nB); c=int(r['replicas'])
        ab,W,u=erlang_a(lam,1/m,c,th); oW.append(float(r['mean_queue_wait_s']));pW.append(W);oa.append(float(r['abandon_rate']));pa.append(ab)
    for r in hist:
        lam=float(r['requests'])/3600; c=int(r['replicas'])
        ab,W,u=erlang_a(lam,1/gA,c,th); oW.append(float(r['mean_queue_wait_s']));pW.append(W);oa.append(float(r['abandon_rate']));pa.append(ab)
    oW=np.array(oW);pW=np.array(pW);oa=np.array(oa);pa=np.array(pa)
    return np.mean(np.log(oW/pW)),np.mean(np.log(oa/pa)),np.std(np.log(oW/pW))
for th in [0.020,0.021,0.02178,0.023,0.024]:
    print(th,ratios(th))
print('gB 7.2',ratios(0.02178,gB=7.2)); print('gB 7.3',ratios(0.02178,gB=7.3))
"
